results.summary_before: MicroTapeout contains 395 standard cells from the sky130_fd_sc_hd library, with a multiplexing mechanism to expose any cell to the input/output pins. It allows low-level digital design engineers to test individual standard cells and gain timing insights. The design includes an experimental timing circuit that uses a ring oscillator and counter to measure cell switching times. Testing involves selecting pages and inputs via the pins, and the design is notable for its large number of cells and educational purpose.

results.summary_before: This design accepts a pulse-density-modulated microphone signal and produces a 4-bit ADPCM encoded output at a lower sampling rate, using a CIC decimation filter followed by ADPCM encoding. It requires two synchronized external clocks, with slow_clk running at one-eighth the frequency of clk, and a block enable signal to start compression. The encoded output streams from the encPcm pins with an outValid flag, and can be stored or decoded for playback. The design is notable for implementing audio compression on a small tile budget and requires an external PDM microphone.
